name: jawal
description: Jawal — SaaS multi-tenant de gestion intégrée d'établissement scolaire

scripts.infra:up: node scripts/stack-guard.mjs && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.infra:down: node scripts/stack-guard.mjs && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.infra:logs: node scripts/stack-guard.mjs && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs -f
scripts.infra:reset: node scripts/stack-guard.mjs && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
